articles.title: GNOME Mutter 50.1 Fixes Performance Regression For Some NVIDIA Driver Versions

Silver Ingots are one of many crafting ingredients you can find in Windrose, and it's slightly tricky to obtain. Unlike the Copper or Iron Ingots, you can't get the Silver variant from smelting. You'll also need to make a fair bit of progress to get access to the items.


This guide will clear all doubts that you might have about Silver Ingots.

How to find Silver Ingots in Windrose


There are two ways to obtain Silver Ingots. The proper method is to purchase them from the Tortuga Goods Seller for 20 Piastre. The price isn't exorbitant, and you can also sell them and get the same amount.


Image via Kraken Express


You can also find Silver Ingots from different quests that can be completed to the warn the item. You can also loot and get it if you're lucky. Try taking on pirate ships if you're brave enough. This is also a great way to find Silver Ingots, but it depends on your luck.


However, you can only find Silver Ingots after you complete the Revenge is Best Served Cold quest. Once you finish the quest, you'll be able to access Silver Ingots.


How to use Silver Ingots in Windrose


Silver Ingots are required for crafting and upgrading different pieces of jewelry. When applied, a Silver Ingot will provide you with different stat boosts, which will have a direct impact on the chances of your success in combat.


However, Silver Ingots are also required for producing the following items.



Reagent Table


Jeweller's Bench


Jewellery Table



Once you're past the beginner stage, you're going to need Silver Ingots pretty regularly. If you're in desperate need of them but can't find it from loot, it's well worth spending your Piastre to get them.

REPLACED is now available on PC and Xbox consoles, and you can tweak your graphics if you're on the former. The general performance is pretty good, and I didn't encounter any stutters as such. However, you can still tweak the settings to get the best possible performance specific to your system.


This guide will help you with strong baseline settings if you're playing on a PC that's close to the minimum requirements.


Best REPLACED graphics settings


Before I deep dive into the settings, here are the details of my current setup.



NVIDIA RTX 3060 12 GB


16 GB of DDR5 RAM


AMD Ryzen 5600G



Incidentally, REPLACED doesn't have recommended settings on its Steam page. However, my system is well above the minimum requirements. Let's look at the current visual settings that I am using for my adventure.



Screen Mode: Borderless. However, you can use Full Screen (I use Borderless since I have a multi-screen setup)


Resolution: 1920x1080 (Default)


FPS Limit: 120


VSync: Off



There are no advanced visual settings, but ideally, the game doesn't have heavy hardware requirements.


Screenshot by Destructoid


I kept VSync off because I did experience minor stutters. When I turned it off, the stutters disappeared. There could have been other factors at play, but so far, it's been good since Vsync went off.


For my system, 120 FPS seems pretty stable, but I won't go limitless. If your system is struggling, you can set the cap lower. The lowest limit is at 30 FPS, which will be perfect if you are on a relatively weaker setup. That way, you'll be able to keep the stutters away while enjoying the game.


That's more or less all the things you need to know to get the best visual performance in REPLACED, irrespective of the quality of your PC hardware.

How to craft the Torn Silcloth Bag in Windrose


The first way to increase inventory size is by using the Torn Sailcloth Bag. This item adds four extra slots to your inventory. You'll need to equip it in the Accessories section, and you'll need to always keep it equipped to get the extra slots.

For starters, you'll need a workbench. Scroll down to the Torn Sailcloth Bag from Plans and Recipes, and choose the recipe. Then, you'll need the following items to craft the bag.



One Rope: To get a Rope, you'll need five Plant Fibers.

If you've obtained the Torn Sailcloth Bag and are still not satisfied with your inventory, you can also craft the Sailor Backpack. You can equip it to get eight extra inventory slots. Sea-faring adventure Windrose can be played solo, but you can also share your exploits with friends. The dedicated servers can support co-op for up to four people. However, you can also have more if you manage your own servers.


Either way, let's look at how you can explore the sea with your buddies on the same ship.


Table of contents
How to invite your friends to Windrose
How to join a friend's game in Windrose


How to invite your friends to Windrose


The process of playing with friends begins by inviting them to your game (I am assuming that you're the host). For starters, add all of them to Steam, as it will make the process simpler. You can send them a friend request using their IDs.


Screenshot by Destructoid


You can play online, but if you want to invite your friends, you'll need to host a game. Select a save: you can either use your own save or create a new one for the co-op experience. Once done, you'll get an invite code (refer to the image above).


Screenshot by Destructoid


Share this ID with your friends, and they will then have to enter the code. Once done, all of you can play together. You can create your own server name, and also add a password for an extra layer of protection. As I said, the official servers can have a maximum of four players at any given time.


How to join a friend's game in Windrose


Screenshot by Destructoid


If you're not hosting a game, you'll need your friend's code to join their adventure. Enter the code, and you'll be able to join the server and play together. If they have a password on their server, you'll need to enter it before you get to join the adventure.

articles.author: Rachel Samples
articles.description:
Over the weekend, hackers breached GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games and threatened to share confidential company information should their demands remain unmet by April 14. Rockstar responded, dismissing the hack’s impact, and now those same hackers are making good on their promise.


ShinyHunters, the group responsible for the hacking, released the data on its website, which is located on the dark web, alongside a message that denied previous reports that the data was ever for sale.


“Your Snowflake instances metrics data was compromised thanks to Anodot.com," the message reads. "We do not operate a Telegram channel and this data was never for sale like reported on X (formerly Twitter) for $200k. It is now leaked. How does it feel to be the headline?”


The leaked data allegedly includes financial information about the online modes for both GTA and Red Dead, as well as the spending data for various countries. According to a report from Kotaku, the data claims the GTA 6 developer makes over $1 million a day from GTA Online. The data does not, however, include any information regarding GTA 6’s source code or other assets from the upcoming game, initial reports suggest.


ShinyHunters was able to pierce Rockstar’s defenses by exploiting a vulnerability in Anodot, an AI analytics tool used by various companies. The hacking group originally demanded that the GTA 6 developer reach out to them by April 14 or have the data leaked.


In response to the initial demands, Rockstar released the following statement on the same day as the original hacking:


“We can confirm that a limited amount of non-material company information was accessed in connection with a third-party data breach,” the company wrote. “This incident has no impact on our organization or our players.”

The post ShinyHunters leaks Rockstar financial data, but GTA 6 appears untouched appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: ShinyHunters leaks Rockstar financial data, but GTA 6 appears untouched

However, the court ruled that the intermediaries must act nonetheless and pick up the bill themselves. This is a clear win for Canal+, which pioneered the blocking expansion.

The landmark ruling is a major victory for internet providers and a major disappointment for the record labels that started the case.

articles.description:
USN-8138-1 fixed a vulnerability in tar-rs. This update provides the
corresponding update for Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that tar-rs incorrectly handled symlinks when unpacking
 a tar archive. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing
 a specially crafted tar archive, a remote attacker could use this issue to
 modify permissions of arbitrary directories outside the extraction root,
 and possibly escalate privileges.
articles.title: USN-8138-2: tar-rs vulnerability

articles.description:
USN-8168-1 fixed a vulnerability in Rust. This update provides the
corresponding update to Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04
LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that tar-rs embedded in rustc incorrectly handled
 symlinks when unpacking a tar archive. If a user or automated system were
 tricked into processing a specially crafted tar archive, a remote attacker
 could use this issue to modify permissions of arbitrary directories
 outside the extraction root, and possibly escalate privileges.
articles.title: USN-8168-2: Rust vulnerability

It was discovered that XML::Parser incorrectly handled certain multi-byte
UTF-8 characters. If a user or automated system were tricked into
processing specially crafted XML data, a remote attacker could use this
issue to cause XML::Parser to crash, resulting in a denial of service or to
possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2006-10002)

It was discovered that XML::Parser incorrectly handled very deep element
nesting. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing
specially crafted XML data, a remote attacker could use this issue to cause
XML::Parser to crash, resulting in a denial of service or to possibly
execute arbitrary code (CVE-2006-10003)

polkit to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-7519)

incorrectly handled long input. A local attacker could possibly use this
issue to cause polkit to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

articles.description:
It was discovered that kvmtool did not properly manage memory under certain
circumstances. A malicious guest attacker could use this issue to cause
kvmtool to crash, leading to a denial of service, or possibly execute
arbitrary code on the host system. (CVE-2021-45464)

It was discovered that kvmtool incorrectly handled the 9p passthrough file
system. A malicious guest attacker could possibly use this issue to open
special files, escape the exported 9p tree, and execute arbitrary code on
the host system. (CVE-2023-2861)
articles.title: USN-8172-1: kvmtool vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Nathan Mills discovered that Vim could crash when parsing certain regular
expressions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 25.10
(CVE-2026-32249)

It was discovered that Vim did not properly sanitize user input. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary commands.
(CVE-2026-33412)

Avishay Matayev discovered that Vim's modeline sandbox could be bypassed
when opening a maliciously-crafted file. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to execute arbitrary commands. This issue only affected Ubuntu
20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 25.10.
(CVE-2026-34982)
articles.title: USN-8171-1: Vim vulnerabilities

token validity check. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause
Corosync to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or to possibly obtain
a small quantity of sensitive information. (CVE-2026-35091)

It was discovered that Corosync incorrectly handled join message
validation. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
Corosync to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-35092)
